methodology: Exact issue #2083 fixture: 120000 files in 400 directories, 20 lines each, 20000 files appended with edited\n. One warmup per tool then five interleaved runs, reversing order each round, with builds/tests idle. Python perf_counter around /usr/bin/time -v; median wall time and maximum peak RSS. API consumer prints each returned DiffEntry, without collecting output. All 20000 rows checked against system Git. Packed copy uses git repack -ad and prune-packed.
verification: Every measured tool returns exactly the same 20000 modified status/path rows as system Git; both 140804-object fixtures pass git fsck --strict.
